words.sense: Characteristically and pleasantly rural, evoking a peaceful countryside setting.
misconceptions: Every attractive setting must be rural to be idyllic.

words.sense: Beautifully peaceful or nearly perfect, in any location.
misconceptions: Every calm rural setting is automatically perfect.

semantic_axes.description: Whether the scene evokes life in the countryside.
Whether the scene is judged almost perfectly serene and satisfying.

edges.boundary_rule: Bucolic points to the pleasant character of rural life; idyllic judges a scene or experience nearly perfect, whether or not it is rural.
clues_b: harmonious scene with nothing to spoil it
perfectly pleasant setting even in a city

misconceptions.M1: Every attractive setting must be rural to be idyllic.
misconceptions.M2: Every calm rural setting is automatically perfect.
misconceptions.M3: Rural details alone tell us everything about how good an experience feels.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Alina’s walk?

beats.text: Alina followed a narrow lane past grazing sheep, vegetable plots, and small farmhouses.
beats.decisive_clue: charming walk through farms and grazing fields
beats.reason: The scene is defined by appealing country features.

beats.text: A tractor occasionally rattled past, leaving dust on her shoes.
beats.decisive_clue: rural atmosphere persists despite dust and tractor noise
beats.reason: The dusty tractor makes the countryside feel lived-in rather than flawlessly perfect.

chains.feedback_short: The dusty tractor makes the countryside feel lived-in rather than flawlessly perfect.
chains.feedback_deep: The scene is defined by appealing country features. The dusty tractor makes the countryside feel lived-in rather than flawlessly perfect. Bucolic paints country life; idyllic paints near-perfection.
chains.contrast_rule: Bucolic paints country life; idyllic paints near-perfection.

hints.attention: Which details establish the character of the setting?
hints.axis: Whether the scene evokes life in the countryside.
hints.contrast: Bucolic paints country life; idyllic paints near-perfection.

beats.text: The lights below twinkled as his closest friends relaxed together.
